title: Interest on the federal debt rose 52% in two years
summary: The federal government spent $48.1 billion in 2024-25 on interest on the money it borrows and on managing Canada's foreign reserves. That's up from $31.7 billion in 2022-23.

title: Benefits paid through the CRA more than doubled in two years
summary: The Canada Revenue Agency paid out $16.2 billion through its benefits program in 2024-25, up from $7.7 billion in 2022-23. The CRA delivers these payments on behalf of the federal government.

title: Spending to settle First Nations land claims more than doubled
summary: Crown-Indigenous Relations spent $8.4 billion on specific claims in 2024-25, up from $3.6 billion in 2022-23. Specific claims settle First Nations grievances over treaties, reserve lands and other assets.
department: Crown-Indigenous Relations and Northern Affairs Canada

title: Military aircraft purchases more than tripled in two years
summary: National Defence spent $3.3 billion buying aircraft and related equipment in 2024-25, up from $945 million in 2022-23.

title: Vaccination spending fell 87% in two years
summary: The Public Health Agency of Canada spent $318 million on vaccination in 2024-25. That's down from $2.5 billion in 2022-23 and $3.0 billion in 2023-24.

title: Emergency response and recovery spending fell 83% in two years
summary: Public Safety Canada spent $426 million on emergency response and recovery in 2024-25. That's down from $2.5 billion in 2022-23 and $467 million in 2023-24.

title: Infectious disease control spending fell 92% in two years
summary: The Public Health Agency of Canada spent $129 million on communicable disease and infection control in 2024-25, down from $1.6 billion in 2022-23.

title: Veterans' disability benefits rose 53% in two years
summary: Veterans Affairs Canada paid $4.2 billion in disability benefits in 2024-25, up from $2.7 billion in 2022-23.

title: Spending on asylum claims more than doubled in two years
summary: Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada spent $2.3 billion on its asylum program in 2024-25, up from $904 million in 2022-23.

title: CMHC housing capacity funding grew more than 7-fold in two years
summary: Canada Mortgage and Housing Corporation spent $1.3 billion on housing expertise and capacity development in 2024-25, up from $169 million in 2022-23.

title: Transport Canada's climate spending grew more than 4-fold
summary: Transport Canada spent $1.2 billion on its climate change and clean air programs in 2024-25, up from $294 million in 2022-23.

title: Energy efficiency spending more than tripled in two years
summary: Natural Resources Canada spent $1.2 billion on energy efficiency programs in 2024-25, up from $357 million in 2022-23.

title: Spending on new Coast Guard ships more than tripled
summary: Fisheries and Oceans Canada spent $1.2 billion on fleet procurement in 2024-25, up from $388 million in 2022-23. This program buys new vessels for the Canadian Coast Guard.

title: Spending on military operations abroad more than doubled
summary: National Defence spent $983 million on international operations in 2024-25, up from $351 million in 2022-23.

title: Climate adaptation spending grew more than 27-fold in two years
summary: Environment and Climate Change Canada spent $570 million on climate change adaptation in 2024-25, up from $21 million in 2022-23.

title: Refugee resettlement spending fell 40% in two years
summary: Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada spent $640 million resettling refugees in 2024-25, down from $1.1 billion in 2022-23.

title: Federal homelessness funding rose 54% in two years
summary: Infrastructure Canada spent $752 million on homelessness funding in 2024-25, up from $489 million in 2022-23.

title: Cost of running the federal payroll rose 51% in two years
summary: Public Services and Procurement Canada spent $683 million administering pay for federal public servants in 2024-25, up from $453 million in 2022-23.
